user.title: Akicon Bath Fan Speaker
user.description: Enter the speaker's Bluetooth MAC address. The integration will try to pair and connect automatically; if that fails, pair it once with bluetoothctl on the Home Assistant host (see the docs).

data_description.mac: The speaker's Bluetooth address, e.g. AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
data_description.audio_device: Leave blank to auto-detect the speaker's PulseAudio sink from its MAC. Only set this for a non-standard sink or PipeWire, e.g. pulse/bluez_output.AA_BB_CC_DD_EE_FF.1.
data_description.mpv_path: Leave as 'mpv'. Ignored when mpv is absent and the ffmpeg fallback is used.

error.invalid_mac: That does not look like a Bluetooth MAC address (expected AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF).

data_description.audio_device: Leave blank to auto-detect the speaker's PulseAudio sink from its MAC. Set only for a non-standard sink or PipeWire.
data_description.mpv_path: Path to the mpv executable. Ignored when the ffmpeg fallback is used.
